subject.title: [Bug]: ensureGlobalUndiciEnvProxyDispatcher() breaks COS chunked upload via qqbot plugin

question: Should the remaining fix for this issue be the broad global/managed proxy NO_PROXY behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97713, or should the issue scope stop at the shipped qqbot guarded upload path?
rationale: Current source appears to protect the qqbot COS PUT path, but the open PR intentionally changes process-wide proxy bypass semantics and needs owner acceptance rather than another automatic issue fix.

options.title: Decide in the linked PR
options.body: Review the linked PR's security-boundary tradeoff and close this issue according to that PR outcome.

options.title: Close as qqbot-scoped fixed
options.body: If maintainers agree the guarded qqbot upload path is the intended fix, close the linked PR as unnecessary and then close this issue with the shipped-code evidence.

options.title: Ask for a narrower repro
options.body: If COS uploads still fail on current main, request a fresh live repro and constrain any fix to the failing transport path.

recommendation.title: Decide in the linked PR
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR's security-boundary tradeoff and close this issue according to that PR outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent trusted env proxy and matchesNoProxy history makes this the strongest routing owner for the proxy-boundary decision.
